text: title and opening permission paragraph (the subject is digital assets and the grant is limited to education, training, research, software/hardware development, performance benchmarking, and product demonstrations); numbered conditions 1-4 (asset-, publication-, endorsement-, and naming-specific terms make this a nonstandard purpose-limited asset license)

text: numbered condition 1 (redistributions must carry the copyright notice, all conditions, the disclaimer, and when applicable a description of differences) and condition 2 (publications showing derived images must carry the copyright notice); the multiple delivery and publication surfaces create a material notice burden

text: numbered condition 1 (retain the copyright notice, list of conditions, and disclaimer and describe applicable differences) and condition 2 (copyright notice on publications showing derived images), supporting include-copyright, include-license-text, and mark-modifications; the publication-specific attribution duty and condition 4's mandatory asset/output naming rule have no exact obligation terms and are represented by unknown

text: complete-text review, including the opening permission paragraph, numbered conditions 1-4, and disclaimer (no patent grant, patent covenant, patent condition, patent-claim restriction, or patent-litigation termination is stated)

text: opening permission paragraph (redistribution and use, with or without modification, are allowed for the listed education, training, research, development, benchmarking, and demonstration purposes, which can include private and commercial settings), supporting commercial-use, distribution, modifications, and private-use; the purpose-limited asset/use grant cannot be expressed losslessly by the permission vocabulary and is represented by unknown; complete-text review finds no express sublicensing, patent, database-right, moral-right, or personality-right grant
